//: Deploy config for running test/load/cleanup.js, not for the app.
//why: A service's start command set through the dashboard or API is OVERRIDDEN by config-as-code, which is how a service meant to run the cleanup ran the load generator instead. So the cleanup gets its own committed config rather than relying on a setting that something else outranks. Point a temporary service at this file, give it DATABASE_URL (a ${{Postgres.DATABASE_URL}} reference is enough — no credential need be handled), deploy, and read the logs. It is a DRY RUN until CLEANUP_CONFIRM=yes.
